I am certain that Iran’s refusal to destroy their enrichment capability will be soundly rejected.

I appreciate President Trump’s earnest efforts to seek a diplomatic solution to change the behavior of the Iranian terrorist regime. I hope everyone had a Happy Mother’s Day full of love and joy. 

It’s hard to believe it’s been almost 50 years since I lost my dear mother. Her love and influence will last a lifetime, like so many other mothers.

Iran’s continued attacks on international shipping and against our allies tells me all I need to know about who we are dealing with here. 

President Trump’s overview of how past presidents have missed the mark in dealing with the Iranian terrorist regime is spot on.  It is apparent to me that Iran believes that President Trump is bluffing when it comes to future military options. 

From my understanding of the situation, that could be a disastrous mistake by the Iranian leadership. Stay tuned.

The idea of Project Freedom Plus is very intriguing and I believe it can bear fruit. Providing a path for safe passage of international shipping in the Strait of Hormuz — in the face of Iranian resistance — is a game changer. The plus part in my opinion would envision more international partners and limited kinetic activity.

Today, I was proud to stand alongside Mayor Touchberry as we announced my Sportsmen Coalition, chaired by Alvin Taylor. 

I’m grateful for the people committed to keeping South Carolina a place where future generations can hunt, fish, shoot, and enjoy the outdoors we all love. 

Thank you for your support.

Congratulations to all the law enforcement officers who received the South Carolina Sheriffs’ Association Medal of Valor this week in Columbia.
 
Thanks to their efforts, crime in South Carolina is at a record low, and I’m pleased these local heroes were honored with the recognition they have earned.
 
Each day, our brave men and women in uniform put their lives on the line to keep our state safe. I will always have their back.
